home_title: You don't have to say it out loud.
home_subtitle: Sakhi is a private, voice-first health companion for women and girls — no name, no account, just help in your language.
home_pill_3: Never a diagnosis — always a real person
triage_intro: Answer a few questions. Nothing you share is tied to your name.
triage_duration: How many days has this been going on?
triage_severity: How severe does it feel? (1 = mild, 5 = very severe)
triage_freetext: Anything else you want to say, in your own words?
triage_pregnant: Are you pregnant, or could you be?
general_intro: For anyone, any symptom. Same triage engine as Sakhi, without the reproductive-health focus — answer a few questions to get routed to the right level of care.
result_not_diagnosis: This is not a diagnosis. Sakhi decides urgency and connects you to care.
cycle_subtitle: Track week by week. Sakhi checks for danger signs automatically.
dashboard_subtitle: Ranked by urgency, with the full reasoning behind every decision.
footer_disclaimer: Sakhi triages and routes. It never diagnoses, never prescribes, and always points toward a real clinician.
kbd_translit_hint: Type in English letters — “bukhaar” becomes your own script as you type.
anaemia_subtitle: Point your camera at your lower eyelid for a private pallor screen.
anaemia_guide: Gently pull down your lower eyelid and frame the pink inner surface in the circle.
anaemia_severity_mild: Mild flag — consider getting a blood test
anaemia_severity_moderate: Moderate flag — we recommend a blood test
anaemia_severity_strong: Strong flag — please get a blood test soon
anaemia_confidence_low: Capture quality: marginal — try again in better light
anaemia_disclaimer: This is a screening flag, not a haemoglobin measurement. Only a blood test can confirm or rule out anaemia.
anaemia_offline: Couldn't complete the screen — please try again or visit a health worker for a blood test.
anaemia_marginal: This capture may not be reliable — try again in better light for a more accurate screen.
anaemia_no_camera: Couldn't open the camera. Check permissions and try again.
anaemia_no_frame: Couldn't read the camera frame. Try again.
anaemia_reject_dark: Too dark — move to better light and try again.
anaemia_reject_bright: Too bright — move out of direct light and try again.
anaemia_reject_uniform: That doesn't look like an eyelid — frame the pink inner surface and try again.
anaemia_reject_nodata: Not enough of the eyelid was in the circle — move closer and try again.
anaemia_reject_notissue: Couldn't find the inner eyelid surface — pull the eyelid down a little more and try again.
anaemia_reject_generic: That capture couldn't be read — please try again.
account_optional_title: You do not need an account
account_optional_body: Everything here works without signing in — checking symptoms, the anaemia screen, helplines and your report. An account only remembers your language.
account_username_hint: Choose any name. Do not use your real name.
account_created: Account created. You can sign in now.
account_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
account_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.
account_stores: This account stores only your username and language. Your health results stay on this phone and are never sent with your account.
account_staff_note: Are you an ASHA or health worker?
offline_body: You can still check symptoms and read your saved report. Results will be sent when the network returns.
